reviewed_metadata.name: ros2_controllers joint trajectory controller implementation
reviewed_metadata.summary: Official C++ ros2_control lifecycle plugin that accepts joint-space trajectory topic/action input, samples trajectories and writes claimed joint command interfaces. The selected source includes goal validation, tolerances and action/state feedback; no robot or successful task execution was verified.

packages: Complete pinned joint_trajectory_controller package, companion sources/headers and a C++17 toolchain
system: Configured ros2_control controller manager/lifecycle host, named joints and matching claimed command/state interfaces
Complete generated parameters, trajectory helpers, robot description and applicable joint/goal constraints
requirements.notes: The selected update reads joint states, samples the companion Trajectory implementation, checks configured tolerances and writes position, velocity, acceleration or effort commands according to selected interfaces. Velocity-only or effort-only configurations can use the PID/feedforward adapter. Configuration creates ~/joint_trajectory input, ~/controller_state output, follow_joint_trajectory action, query_state service and conditional speed-scaling input. It handles goal preemption/cancellation and configured hold/deceleration paths; stopping safety and real-time performance were not tested. Companion trajectory.cpp, headers, generated parameter YAML/validators and their behavior are required but were not reviewed. lifecycle_msgs is explicitly included in this source; the other listed build/runtime dependencies come from package.xml/CMake. Optional BUILD_TESTING has additional declared test dependencies. CMake requests C++17; package 4.43.0 and the jazzy checkout are declarations, not tested ROS, OS, architecture, controller or robot combinations.

reviewed_metadata.invocation_notes: The plugin XML registers type joint_trajectory_controller::JointTrajectoryController and shared library joint_trajectory_controller. The source exports that class with PLUGINLIB_EXPORT_CLASS. A configured controller manager/lifecycle host calls on_configure/on_activate/update; this is not a standalone ros2 run program or a Hub recipe. Joint-space trajectory construction and kinematics remain caller/package responsibilities. Loading an appropriately configured host can write actual hardware command interfaces. The Hub retrieves one inert file only and did not build, load or execute the plugin.

reviewed_metadata.name: ros2_controllers differential-drive controller implementation
reviewed_metadata.summary: Official C++ ros2_control chainable plugin that consumes stamped linear/angular velocity references, applies configured limits and computes left/right wheel velocity commands. It integrates odometry through a companion helper and publishes configured odometry/TF output; runtime and physical behavior remain untested.

packages: Complete pinned diff_drive_controller package, companion sources/headers and a C++17 toolchain
system: Configured ros2_control lifecycle/controller manager host and matching left/right wheel velocity command interfaces
Configured wheel names, radii/separation, velocity limits, timing and odometry frames; position/velocity feedback unless configured open_loop
requirements.notes: The subscriber path uses the package TwistStamped alias on ~/cmd_vel and checks timestamp age; timeout 0 disables this timeout. The chainable class exposes linear/angular velocity reference interfaces. update_and_write_commands applies speed limiters, computes wheel rates from linear x/angular z and configured geometry, and writes loaned wheel command handles. It delegates odometry to odometry.cpp, publishes ~/odom and conditional /tf and ~/cmd_vel_out, and halt writes zero wheel commands during deactivation. These are source operations, not verified stopping, odometry accuracy or timing. Complete headers, odometry/speed-limiter helpers and generated parameter YAML/validators were not reviewed and remain required. Package/CMake declare the listed build/runtime dependencies; lifecycle_msgs, class_loader and rosidl_runtime_cpp also appear directly in this source. Optional BUILD_TESTING has additional declared test dependencies. C++17, package 4.43.0 and the jazzy checkout are declarations, not tested environment combinations.

reviewed_metadata.invocation_notes: The plugin XML registers type diff_drive_controller::DiffDriveController, base controller_interface::ChainableControllerInterface and shared library diff_drive_controller. This source registers that class with CLASS_LOADER_REGISTER_CLASS; CMake exports diff_drive_plugin.xml. A complete configured controller manager/lifecycle host supplies interfaces and invokes subscriber/reference and command updates. This is not a standalone executable or Hub adapter. When loaded by an authorized host it can command actual wheels and publish ROS messages; fetching this reference never loads or executes it.
